name: Facet
text: Add a floating, always-visible legend that updates in real time as the user hovers over data points. This keeps the interface clean by hiding clutter when not needed, while ensuring users never lose context—critical for fast, confident decisions. The trade-off is screen space, but clarity and speed outweigh the cost.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A floating legend that updates on hover risks hiding critical controls when the user needs them most—like when they’re mid-task and the legend obscures the very button they need to act. Instead, anchor the legend to the edge of the graph and let it collapse into a thin strip; users keep context without sacrificing control. Settle this by testing whether users can complete a timed decision task with each layout—speed and accuracy don’t lie.

name: Facet
text:
Choose a collapsible sidebar legend pinned to the left edge of the graph. It stays out of the way until opened with one click, preserving screen space for controls while keeping context visible. This balances clarity and speed—users get instant access to legend details without clutter, and the legend won’t block critical actions when collapsed. The trade-off is a slight extra click to open, but it’s faster than hunting for hidden information.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A collapsible sidebar still forces users to *choose* between legend and data—either scroll to read or lose context mid-hover. Instead, embed the legend directly into the graph’s canvas as a semi-transparent overlay that fades on idle, preserving both visibility and control. Settle this with a 5-user usability test: track hover-to-decision time with each design—if the overlay adds >1 second of hesitation, it fails.

name: Lumen
text:
DECISION: Embed the legend as a semi-transparent overlay on the graph canvas, fading on idle but reappearing instantly on hover or click—balancing visibility, context, and control without sacrificing screen space.

Result must deliver: A legend that never blocks critical controls, updates in real time, and feels effortless to use. Owned by Facet (visualization-w1).
